scope: Read-only Account catalog migration lifecycle conflict; draft source mutable under sole implementation author

facts.finding: Immutable migration forbids every console_app membership except original two; superuser applier does not bypass this membership check.
prepare_migration_database_connection checks actual pg_auth_members and transitive memberships, allowing only original two writers plus implicit pg_database_owner.

run_migrations uses direct console_app physical connection, calls full embedded SQLx migrator and Apalis, then reasserts same identity. Extra owner memberships before or after migrations violate actual production boundary.

prepare_http_database verifies empty marked disposable admin-owned database, transfers database ownership to console_app and calls production run_migrations with actual owner LOGIN. It does not apply schemas as fake/admin fixture.
Existing deployment orders admin topology -> migrate -> API/worker. No post-migration custody finalization currently exists.
Draft requires new NOLOGIN owners and attempts ALTER TABLE OWNER under console_app; removing membership grants alone makes transfer unavailable.

recommendation.approach: Keep new custody owners NOLOGIN with zero membership edges; retain original exact two console_app memberships. Separate database-local catalog creation and explicit administrator ownership finalization, using existing topology admin transport and a named production finalization stage.
ordered_contract: Pre-migration topology provisions/validates two restrictive NOLOGIN owner roles with no inbound/outbound memberships; no temporary role reachability granted to migration/runtime logins.

0226 creates exactly six empty dormant relations as console_app and revokes PUBLIC/runtime/table/column/default-derived exposure in the same transaction. It does not attempt privileged ownership transfer or fabricate finalization success.

After canonical run_migrations succeeds, existing authorized cluster-admin transport performs explicit per-database finalization in one transaction: verify intended database and migration/checksum state, exact relation kind/schema and expected source/target ownership; transfer only six named objects, enforce exact ACL/role invariants and atomically verify final state.

Production orchestration treats schema applied and custody finalized as distinct states. Startup/readiness for the new Account feature must verify final actual custody before serving; deployment must not report complete after migrations alone. Old runtime cannot access pending dormant relations.

Repeat finalization idempotently on exact already-finalized state; fail closed on partial/unexpected relation shape/owner/ACL, with transaction rollback. Concurrent finalizers use database-local coordination; no cluster-global grant window.

SQLx preparation calls the same production finalizer through its already-proven disposable admin identity after run_migrations; it must not reproduce ownership/DDL inline. General fixtures follow actual lifecycle and assertions remain unchanged.

recommendation.authority_boundary: This changes deployment completion and fixture lifecycle contracts and needs a revision-bound material design/test amendment. It is not authorized by the earlier exact4membership test delta. Production finalizer must exist before changing fixture to invoke it.

alternatives.reason: Shared role membership affects every database and concurrent migration/API connection. Grants may survive interruption or existing SET ROLE sessions; cleanup is not revocation proof. Transactional membership visibility also fails to deliver a usable grant across separate migrator connections, while a committed window interferes with another database executing0165.

alternatives.option: Split historical migrator and change current authority to allow four owner memberships
alternatives.reason: Every fresh database still replays immutable0165; final shared topology cannot remain four while another database bootstraps. Requires cluster-wide serialized phase coordinator and fences, not simple per-database migration batching.

alternatives.option: Run entire migrator as admin or test-only owner reassignment
alternatives.reason: Violates actual direct console_app production identity boundary; fixture-only fallback hides readiness failure.

alternatives.option: Admin-installed database-local SECURITY DEFINER ownership helper
alternatives.verdict: Possible separately reviewed alternative, not free fix
alternatives.reason: Could keep creation+transfer atomic under owner migrator without global grants, but introduces privileged callable DDL authority, installation lifecycle and trusted search_path/object validation/replacement/replay constraints. Fixed allowlist alone is insufficient against hostile object definitions or ownership. More enduring attack surface than one-shot existing admin finalization for six dormant relations.

required_meaningful_tests: Fresh real database: original two memberships -> all immutable migrations including0165 -> real direct console_app run_migrations -> actual admin finalizer -> exact six owner/ACL assertions.
Existing migrated database upgrade, idempotent finalizer/reconciliation restart, and exact original historical checksums retained.
Pending finalization cannot serve new Account functionality; no runtime/table/column/SET reachability before or after finalization.
Unexpected/partial catalog, wrong database/owner/migration identity, and unauthorized finalizer caller refuse without partial ownership/ACL mutation.
Failure after migration and before/during finalization resumes deterministically; successful post-state readback distinguishes commit ambiguity from no effect.
Two databases sharing cluster: one replays0165 while another finalizes six relations; console_app memberships stay exact two throughout and neither job weakens the other database.
SQLx fixtures invoke same production lifecycle without inline role/schema repair; selected catalog tests reach actual assertions.
prior_test_delta_disposition: Earlier topology-test-independent-review accepted the exact membership4 extension conditional on approved ownership needs. New actual migration evidence disproves that lifecycle compatibility premise; retain prior receipt historically, do not apply that patch as resolution. Under recommended no-membership design original2edge expectations stay and only strict new-role/zero-edge assertions extend them.
